title: USAspending Scraper — US Federal Contracts & Grants
description: Every US federal contract, IDV, grant, loan and direct payment from the official USAspending.gov awards API — plus the sub-contracts and sub-grants filed under them, joined to the prime award. 51 typed fields incl. recipient UEI/address, NAICS/PSC, CFDA. Filter by agency, keyword, state, date.
seoTitle: USAspending Scraper — US Federal Contracts & Grants API
seoDescription: Scrape US federal procurement contracts, grants, loans and sub-awards from USAspending.gov's spending-transparency portal. 51 fields: recipient UEI, NAICS/PSC, CFDA. Filter by agency, state, date.

result.eventDescription: One normalized US federal award or sub-award returned to the dataset.
